find-jelenneth.title: Find Jelenneth or Learn Her Fate
find-jelenneth.summary: Search for Jelenneth, the missing daughter of Parker and Heldrith Laneworth. Rescue her, or learn her fate so her family can have closure.
objectives: Find and rescue Jelenneth, or learn what happened to her.
Return reliable news to her family.

three-items-for-nuanda.title: Three Items for Nuanda Nemere
three-items-for-nuanda.summary: Retrieve the three ritual ingredients Nuanda Nemere requested and bring them to her before she no longer needs them.
objectives: Obtain an amethyst worth at least 50 gp.
Obtain hair from a deceased orc.
Obtain Hwyanthemon.
three-items-for-nuanda.reward: 800 XP each for up to four eligible PCs

k-r-k-caravan-run.title: The K-R-K Caravan Run
k-r-k-caravan-run.summary: Guard Billworth Turgen's caravan from Kirkilston to Raven's Pass and see its cargo safely delivered.
objectives: Protect the caravan and its travelers.
Deliver the surviving wagons to Raven's Pass.
k-r-k-caravan-run.reward: 15 gp each, a meal, and Billworth's offer of future work

plumb-lost-caverns.title: Plumb the Depths of the Lost Caverns
plumb-lost-caverns.summary: Explore the rediscovered Lost Caverns of Achaia on behalf of the mage Delk Whitewand.
objectives: Confirm and enter the Lost Caverns of Achaia.
Explore the caverns and recover their lost secrets.
Give any recovered scrolls and tomes to Delk.
plumb-lost-caverns.reward: 100 gp up front, 10 gp daily, useful potions, and other recovered treasure

reclaim-keep-on-borderlands.title: Reclaim the Keep on the Borderlands
reclaim-keep-on-borderlands.summary: Clear the goblins and bugbears from the abandoned keep that may stand over the ancient dwarf-hold Kharaz-Ankor.
objectives: Clear the keep of its goblin and bugbear occupants.
Investigate the possible entrance to the ancient dwarf-hold.
reclaim-keep-on-borderlands.reward: 25 gp daily for the party for up to 14 days, plus 5 gp per goblin tongue

construct-darkforest-fort.title: Help Reglar Ashbow Construct a Fort in the Darkforest
construct-darkforest-fort.summary: Help Reglar Ashbow construct a fort on the eastern shore of Donally Lake in the Darkforest.
objectives: Meet Reglar Ashbow and agree upon the work.
Travel to the eastern shore of Donally Lake.
Help construct and secure the fort.

find-urvan-and-narinza.title: Find Urvan and Narinza
find-urvan-and-narinza.summary: Determine what happened to Urvan and Narinza after they were separated from the party during the flight from Blightstone Pit.
objectives: Follow signs of the missing companions from Blightstone Pit.
Find Urvan and Narinza, or learn their fates.

free-slaytonthorpe.title: Free Slaytonthorpe from the Terror of Red Tusk
free-slaytonthorpe.summary: Fulfill Cromm's command to Neria by discovering the nature of Red Tusk and ending the terror afflicting Slaytonthorpe.
objectives: Learn who or what Red Tusk is.
Travel to Slaytonthorpe.
Free Slaytonthorpe from Red Tusk's terror.

investigate-cold-mouth.title: Investigate the Cold Mouth and the Deep Friends
investigate-cold-mouth.summary: Investigate the Cold Mouth named in the recovered Toothbreaker orders and identify the Deep Friends collecting captives there.
objectives: Locate the Cold Mouth north of Slaytonthorpe.
Identify Red Tusk and the Deep Friends.
Discover what happened to the captives taken there.
